1879064327.name: Trip
1879064327.desc: While Stealthed, stun an enemy to enable a Fellowship Manoeuvre for your group.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879073287.name: Tangle-foot
1879073287.desc: While Stealthed, stun an enemy to enable a Fellowship Manoeuvre for your group.\n\nDoes not break Stealth.

1879097863.name: Pack Hunters
1879097863.desc:
Wargs are pack hunters. You can target a foe and increase the damage dealt by all members of your war party, while reducing their incoming healing.<rgb=#FF7700>

In Flayer: Pack Flayer
Roots target in place, causing them to be unable to block, parry, or evade attacks.

In Shadow: Shadow Pack
Lowers the defence and incoming healing of all enemies around the Warg.</rgb>

1879099271.name: Mentor: Clarinet
1879099271.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the clarinet.

1879108999.name: Bastion of Light
1879108999.desc: Your connexion to the Light manifests beneath your feet; marking targets within the light making them susceptible to your debuffs.

1879113735.name: Earthborn: Strength of the Earth
1879113735.desc: Quickly regain Morale and Power in combat.

1879198343.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Onyx Sabre-cat)
1879198343.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879214599.name: Persevere
1879214599.desc: A shield strike, which heals you over time and increases incoming healing.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879231367.name: Ranged Boar's Rush
1879231367.desc: A fast shield rush deals significant damage to enemies in front of you.

1879239559.name: Noble Arrow
1879239559.desc: The Noble Arrow, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

procEffects.description: On every Harmful skill,\n50% chance on Critical Hit:
On every Harmful skill,\nOn Critical Hit:

1879241991.name: Pledge to Rohan
1879241991.desc: Issuing a pledge to the land of Rohan you support your fellowship and strengthen yourself in the process.

1879244423.name: Ranged Resounding Challenge
1879244423.desc: Your challenge echoes in the ears of your foes.

conditionalEffects.description: The Resounding Challenge Gambit deals instant bonus damage instead of applying damage over time.

1879260039.name: Imp. Quick Shot: Flaming Arrow
1879260039.desc:
Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

Has a chance to generate additional Focus.

Arrows inflict fire damage.

1879263623.name: Lay Trap
1879263623.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879270919.name: Lissuin Horse
1879270919.desc: A horse from the Spring Festival.

1879276551.name: Enfeebling Cry
1879276551.desc: Your battle cry slows your enemies, causing them to be uncertain about their next actions.

1879319175.name: Vicious Claws: Claw
1879319175.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action.\n\nDeals increased damage.

1879331463.name: Steed of Ethuil
1879331463.desc: A horse from the Spring Festival.

1879342471.name: Steed of the Unflagging Dragon
1879342471.desc: A steed from the 10-year Anniversary Festival.

1879358087.name: Athelas Healing
1879358087.desc: Elvish soldiers often carry Athelas to aid in the healing of wounds.

1879365767.name: Flower Petals
1879365767.desc: Summon a swirl of flower petals to enchant your friends.

1879387911.name: Guide to Beorninghús
1879387911.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Beorninghús.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879417095.name: Tame Wildwood Tusker
1879417095.desc: Summons a Wildwood boar to keep you company.

1879430279.name: Guide to the Noble Gate
1879430279.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the Noble Gate.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879457543.name: Readied Blade
1879457543.desc: Brandish your blade to increase your defences.\nGrants immunity to Disarms.

1879466247.name: Blade Shield
1879466247.desc:
Adopt a defensive stance with your blade, increasing your chance to Parry incoming attacks.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Step Back reduces Incoming Damage.
 Riposte deals more damage.</rgb>
<rgb=#ecdd11> Riposte increases your target's Incoming Damage.</rgb>

1879500423.name: Glorfindel's Aid
1879500423.desc:
Call upon Glorfindel to empower his Elf-stone to purge the essence of the void seeping into Middle-earth.
<rgb=#00FF00>Destroys active blisters around you.</rgb>

To use this skill, you must be near Glorfindel.

1879508743.name: Sail to Jiret-menêsh
1879508743.desc: Navigate to Jiret-menêsh in An Shêru in Mûr Ghala with nearby fellows.

1879521287.name: Well-laden Mûmak Calf
1879521287.desc: Summons a helpful well-laden mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.

1879523207.name: Searing Cry of the Wizards
1879523207.desc: Call upon a powerful song to blast your enemies with an area-of-effect of light that will slow the creatures who are hit by it.

1879525255.name: Flower Petals
1879525255.desc: A bag of fresh rose petals. You seem to have quite a bit of it.
